name: reddit-outreach
description: 24/7 Reddit lead-gen: a watch agent that finds ad-runner/after-hours-lead prospects and a scout agent that discovers target subreddits. Two workers coordinating through Postgres.

ZERNIO_API_KEY.description: Zernio API key — live Reddit read + send (no Reddit API key needed).

FIREWORKS_API_KEY.description: Fireworks AI key for LLM qualification/drafting (or use OPENAI/GROQ/ANTHROPIC).

REDDIT_BACKEND.description: Must be zernio (or rdt) on cloud — opencli needs a desktop browser.

REDDIT_FALLBACK.description: Optional read-fallback backend if the primary read errors/empties (e.g. rdt). Requires rdt-cli installed + logged in.

CAMPAIGN.description: Path to the campaign file this deployment runs (the 'mold').

DASHBOARD_TOKEN.description: Shared secret for the read-only web dashboard. Use a long random string. Unset = dashboard locks itself.

SWARM_ACCOUNTS.description: Warm-up swarm roster as a JSON/YAML string (only if you run the warm worker). See accounts.example.yaml.
